target_moa.text: Semisynthetic lipoglycopeptide antibiotic; inhibits bacterial cell wall synthesis by interfering with polymerization and cross-linking of peptidoglycan, and binds to and disrupts the bacterial membrane barrier function, giving concentration-dependent bactericidal activity against Gram-positive organisms

citations.quote: Telavancin inhibits bacterial cell wall synthesis by interfering with the polymerization and cross-linking of peptidoglycan. Telavancin binds to the bacterial membrane and disrupts membrane barrier function.

Telavancin is a semisynthetic, lipoglycopeptide antibiotic. Telavancin exerts concentration-dependent, bactericidal activity against Gram-positive organisms *in vitro*, as demonstrated by time-kill assays and MBC/MIC (minimum bactericidal concentration/minimum inhibitory concentration) ratios using broth dilution methodology.
Telavancin is a semisynthetic, lipoglycopeptide antibiotic.
